X-γ Radiation Dose Alarm FC902

Detector Type: CsI + SiPM Solid-State Photomultiplier
Dose Rate Range: 0.01 μSv/h - 1 mSv/h
Personal dose monitoring for radiological workers; environmental monitoring near nuclear facilities; radioactive material screening at customs and borders; radiation safety inspections for health and environmental agencies.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC902 series is a compact pen-type high-sensitivity X-γ radiation dose alarm. The instrument uses a high-speed, low-power embedded microprocessor as the data processing unit, and the detector module uses a high-sensitivity scintillator detector. The instrument features fast response, wide measurement range, and broad application scope. It can monitor X and γ rays, and is a universal portable radiation measurement instrument.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • Uses CsI cesium iodide scintillator + SiPM solid-state photomultiplier.
  • Full-color TFT LCD display, supports Chinese and English operation interface.
  • Compact pen-type design, with built-in back clip, can be fitted with lanyard, convenient to carry.
  • Can simultaneously measure and display dose rate and accumulated dose.
  • Automatic range switching, automatic saving of accumulated dose; accumulated dose and accumulated time are permanently saved after power off.
  • Customizable dose rate and accumulated dose alarm thresholds.
  • Supports four alarm modes: sound, vibration, sound+vibration, and silent.
  • Built-in 1100mA large-capacity rechargeable lithium battery, supports real-time voltage indication.
  • Equipped with automatic fault detection and protection function, anti-electromagnetic interference.
  • Can continuously save 98,300 real-time records and 32,760 alarm records.
  • Data can be exported via USB (requires optional dedicated software).
  • Optional Bluetooth communication and mobile phone mini-program.

Package Contents

  • Instrument, lanyard, USB charging cable, protective case, user manual, warranty card, certificate of conformity

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Detector TypeCsI + SiPM Solid-State Photomultiplier
Gamma SensitivityApprox. 70cps / (μSv/h) (relative to 137Cs)
Relative Basic ErrorNot exceeding ±15% (at 10μSv/h, 137Cs)
Dose Rate Range0.01 μSv/h - 1 mSv/h
Protection Alarm Response Time≤1 second
Data ExportUSB (Bluetooth version supports USB + Bluetooth mini-program)
Accumulated Dose0.00μSv - 9999Sv
X-γ Energy Range25keV - 3.0MeV
Energy Response ErrorNot exceeding ±30% (relative to 137Cs)
Dose Rate Alarm ThresholdAdjustable within full range
Accumulated Dose Alarm ThresholdAdjustable within full range
Display UnitsDose rate: μSv/h, mSv/h auto-switching; μR/h, mR/h auto-switching; Accumulated dose: μSv, mSv, Sv auto-switching; Count rate: cps
Power SupplyBuilt-in 3.7V, 1100mA lithium battery, USB TYPE-C charging interface
Dimensions & WeightL×W×H (118×28×16) mm, 20mm with back clip; Weight: 60g
Operating Environment-15℃ to +50℃, relative humidity ≤95% (40±2)℃
